title: be 动词:am / is / are
summary: 英语用 be 动词表达"是/处于某种状态",是英语的第一块基石。
points: 主语 I → am
单数主语(he / she / it / 名词单数)→ is
复数主语(you / we / they / 名词复数)→ are
否定:be + not(如 is not / isn't)
疑问:把 be 提到主语前(如 Are you...?)

examples.en: I am a student.
She is at home.
They are friends.

questions.explanation: 主语 I 固定搭配 am。
she 是单数第三人称,用 is。
they 是复数,用 are。
it 是单数,否定用 is not。
you 与 are 搭配;疑问句把 are 提前。
we 是复数,用 are。

title: 人称代词与物主代词
summary: 分清"主格作主语、宾格作宾语、形容词性物主代词+名词",是造句的基本功。
points: 主格(作主语):I / you / he / she / it / we / they
宾格(作宾语):me / you / him / her / it / us / them
形容词性物主代词(+名词):my / your / his / her / its / our / their
口诀:主格当"主角",宾格当"对象",物主代词后面必跟名词

examples.en: This is my book.
Can you help me?
She lost her keys.

questions.explanation: 后面有名词 book,用形容词性物主代词 my。
作动词 help 的宾语,用宾格 me。
作主语,用主格 He。
后面跟名词 teacher,用 our。
介词 at 后接宾格 them。
后面有名词 keys,用 her。

title: 名词单复数
summary: 英语名词有单复数之分,复数形式的规则变化与常见不规则变化都要熟记。
points: 一般情况加 -s:book → books
以 s / x / ch / sh 结尾加 -es:box → boxes
辅音字母 + y 结尾:变 y 为 i 加 -es:city → cities
不规则变化:man → men,child → children,tooth → teeth

examples.en: I have two boxes.
There are many children in the park.
These cities are very big.

questions.explanation: 以 x 结尾加 -es。
child 是不规则变化。
辅音字母 + y,变 y 为 i 加 -es。
一般情况直接加 -s。
man → men 是不规则变化。
以 ch 结尾加 -es。

title: 一般现在时
summary: 表达习惯、事实与常态的时态;主语是第三人称单数时动词要加 -s / -es。
points: 肯定:I / you / we / they + 动词原形;he / she / it + 动词加 -s / -es
三单变化:一般加 -s;辅音字母 + y 变 y 为 i 加 -es(study → studies)
否定:don't / doesn't + 动词原形
疑问:Do / Does + 主语 + 动词原形
常搭配 usually / every day / often 等时间词

examples.en: I study English every day.
She goes to school by bus.
They don't like cold weather.
examples.zh: 他们不喜欢寒冷的天气。

questions.explanation: she 是第三人称单数,go 加 -es。
she 是三单;辅音字母 + y 结尾,变 y 为 i 加 -es → studies。
they 是复数,否定用 don't。
he 是三单,疑问助动词用 Does。
my mother 是三单,cook 加 -s。
we 是复数,否定用 don't + 原形。

title: 现在进行时
summary: 表示此刻正在进行的动作,结构是 be + 动词-ing。
points: 肯定:主语 + am / is / are + V-ing
否定:be + not + V-ing
疑问:把 be 提到主语前
V-ing 规则:一般直接加 -ing;以不发音 e 结尾去 e 加 -ing(write → writing)
重读闭音节双写末尾辅音字母再加 -ing(run → running)
常搭配 now / look! / listen!

examples.en: I am reading a book.
She is cooking in the kitchen.
They are playing football.

questions.explanation: Look! 提示动作正在进行,用 is raining。
主语 I 配 am,加 V-ing。
they 配 are,疑问句把 are 提前。
be 后面接 V-ing。
后半句说他在学习,前面应是否定 isn't。
Listen! 提示正在进行,birds 配 are singing。

title: there be 句型
summary: "某处有某物"用 there be 句型;后面的名词是单数或不可数用 is,复数用 are。
points: There is + 单数名词 / 不可数名词
There are + 复数名词
否定:There isn't / aren't (+ any)
疑问:Is / Are there...?
就近原则:be 与离它最近的名词保持一致

examples.en: There is a park near my home.
There are many books on the desk.
Is there a hospital near here?

questions.explanation: a book 是单数,用 There is。
two cats 是复数,用 There are。

questions.prompt: ___ there any milk in the glass?
questions.explanation: milk 是不可数名词,按单数对待,用 Is。

questions.prompt: There ___ some children in the park.
questions.explanation: children 是复数,用 are。

questions.prompt: There ___ a pen and two books on the table.
questions.explanation: 就近原则:be 靠最近的 a pen,用 is。

questions.prompt: There isn't ___ bread on the plate.
questions.explanation: 否定句中 some 变 any。

title: 一般过去时
summary: 表示过去发生的动作或状态,动词要用过去式。
points: 规则动词加 -ed:work → worked
不规则动词需记忆:go → went,have → had,be → was / were
否定:didn't + 动词原形
疑问:Did + 主语 + 动词原形
常搭配 yesterday / last week / ... ago

examples.en: I watched a movie yesterday.
She went to Beijing last week.
He didn't come yesterday.

questions.explanation: yesterday 提示过去时,watch 加 -ed。
go 的过去式是不规则变化 went。
have 的过去式是 had。
过去时疑问用 Did + 原形。
didn't 后面接动词原形。
it 是单数,be 的过去式用 was。

title: 一般将来时
summary: 表示将来发生的动作;常用 will + 动词原形,或 be going to + 动词原形表示计划。
points: will + 动词原形:临时决定、预测
be going to + 动词原形:已有计划、打算
否定:will not = won't
疑问:Will + 主语 + 动词原形?
常搭配 tomorrow / next week / soon

examples.en: I will call you tomorrow.
We are going to travel in August.
It will rain tonight.

questions.explanation: will 后接动词原形,will 没有三单变化。
be going to + 动词原形,表示计划。
预测用 will + 原形。
will 的疑问句把 Will 提前。
won't = will not,后面接动词原形。

questions.prompt: We ___ going to watch a movie tonight.
questions.explanation: we 配 are,构成 are going to。

title: 情态动词 can / must / should
summary: 情态动词表达能力、必须与建议,后面一律接动词原形,没有人称变化。
points: can + 动词原形:能力(会)、许可(可以)
must + 动词原形:必须;mustn't 表示禁止
should + 动词原形:应该,用于提建议
情态动词没有人称变化:he can(不是 he cans)
疑问:把情态动词提到主语前(Can you...?)

examples.en: I can swim very well.
You must finish it today.
You should drink more water.

questions.explanation: can 表能力,后接原形,无单复数变化。
情态动词没有人称变化,仍是 can。

questions.prompt: You ___ finish your homework before dinner.
questions.explanation: must 表必须,后接原形。
should 表建议,后接原形。
请求许可用 Can I...?
mustn't 后接动词原形,late 是形容词,所以用 be。

title: 形容词比较级与最高级
summary: 形容词有原级、比较级(-er / more)与最高级(-est / most)三个等级;比较级用 than 连接比较对象,最高级前加 the。
points: 单音节形容词一般加 -er / -est:tall → taller → tallest
以 e 结尾只加 -r / -st:nice → nicer → nicest
重读闭音节双写末尾字母再加 -er / -est:big → bigger → biggest
多音节形容词用 more / most:beautiful → more beautiful → most beautiful
比较级 + than;最高级前加 the,常用 in / of 短语说明范围

examples.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
Tom is the tallest in our class.
Today is hotter than yesterday.

questions.prompt: This apple is ___ than that one.
questions.explanation: big 双写 g 加 -er 构成比较级,than 提示用比较级。

questions.prompt: Lucy is the ___ student in our class.
questions.explanation: the 提示最高级;good 是不规则变化:good → better → best。

questions.prompt: This film is ___ interesting than that one.
questions.explanation: 多音节词 interesting 用 more 构成比较级,不能加 -er。
than 提示比较级;单音节 tall 直接加 -er。
the 提示最高级;hot 双写 t 加 -est。

questions.prompt: The red bag is ___ of the three.
questions.explanation: of the three 提示三者比较用最高级;cheap 直接加 -est。

title: 冠词 a / an / the
summary: a / an 表示泛指"某一个",the 表示特指;a 用在辅音音素开头的词前,an 用在元音音素开头的词前。
points: a + 辅音音素开头的词:a book,a university
an + 元音音素开头的词:an apple,an hour(h 不发音)
the 特指双方都知道或上文提过的事物:the sun,the door
首次提到用 a / an,再次提到用 the
三餐、球类运动前通常不加冠词:have lunch,play basketball

examples.en: I have a dog. The dog is very cute.
examples.zh: 我有一只狗。这只狗很可爱。

examples.en: She is an English teacher.
The sun rises in the east.

questions.prompt: I have ___ apple in my bag.
questions.explanation: apple 以元音音素开头,泛指用 an。
honest 的 h 不发音,以元音音素开头,用 an。
useful 以辅音音素 /j/ 开头,用 a。

questions.prompt: I bought a pen yesterday. ___ pen is blue.
questions.explanation: 再次提到上文的事物,用 the 特指。
球类运动前不加冠词。
世界上独一无二的事物(如 the moon)前用 the。

title: 疑问句:一般疑问句与特殊疑问句
summary: 一般疑问句把 be / 情态动词 / 助动词提到主语前,用 Yes 或 No 回答;特殊疑问句用疑问词开头,问人、时间、地点、方式。
points: 一般疑问句:把 be 动词、情态动词或助动词提到主语前面,读升调
一般疑问句用 Yes / No 回答:— Do you like tea? — Yes, I do.
特殊疑问句:疑问词 + 一般疑问句的语序:Where do you live?
常见疑问词:what 什么、where 哪里、when 何时、who 谁、why 为什么、how 怎样
疑问词 who / what 作主语时,后面直接跟动词:Who wants to play?

examples.en: Do you like apples? Yes, I do.
examples.zh: 你喜欢苹果吗?是的,我喜欢。

examples.en: Where does your sister work?
Who wants to play football with us?
examples.zh: 谁想和我们一起踢足球?

examples.en: How do you go to school every day?

questions.prompt: ___ you play the piano after dinner?
questions.explanation: 主语是 you,一般现在时,助动词用 Do 提前。
主语 brother 是第三人称单数,用 Does 提前。

questions.prompt: — Do you like tea? — Yes, I ___.
questions.explanation: 用助动词 do 回答,前后保持一致。

questions.prompt: ___ is your birthday? — It's in May.
questions.explanation: 问时间用 When。

questions.prompt: ___ is the man over there? — He is my uncle.
questions.explanation: 问"是谁"用 Who。

questions.prompt: ___ does the train leave? — At nine o'clock.
questions.explanation: 问具体时刻用 What time。

title: 频度副词 always / usually / often / sometimes / never
summary: 频度副词表示动作发生的频率;位置是"be 动词之后、实义动词之前",对频率提问用 How often。
points: 频率从高到低:always 总是 > usually 通常 > often 经常 > sometimes 有时 > never 从不
频度副词放在 be 动词之后:She is never late.
频度副词放在实义动词之前:I usually get up at six.
sometimes 可以放句首或句尾:Sometimes I go swimming.
never 本身表示否定,句中不再加 not
对频率提问用 How often:How often do you exercise?

examples.en: I always brush my teeth before bed.
She is never late for class.
How often do you play basketball? — Twice a week.
examples.zh: 你多久打一次篮球?每周两次。

examples.en: We sometimes go swimming on Sundays.

questions.prompt: My father ___ watches the news after dinner. He never misses it.
questions.explanation: 每天都不错过,频率是 100%,用 always。

questions.prompt: Lucy is ___ late for school. In fact, she arrives earliest every day.
questions.explanation: 每天到得最早,说明从不迟到;频度副词放在 is 之后。

options: He usually gets up at six.
He gets up usually at six.
He usually get up at six.
Usually he get up at six.
questions.explanation: 频度副词放在实义动词 gets 之前,且主语 He 后动词要加 -s。

questions.prompt: — ___ do you visit your grandparents? — Once a month.
questions.explanation: 问频率(多久一次)用 How often。

questions.prompt: I ___ eat fast food because it is not healthy.
questions.explanation: 快餐不健康,所以从来不吃;never 自身表否定。
always 意为"总是",频率是 100%。

title: 介词 in / on / at:时间与地点
summary: 时间上 at 接时刻、on 接具体某天、in 接年月季节;地点上 at 接小地点、on 接表面、in 接大地点或内部。
points: 时间:at + 时刻(at seven, at noon, at night)
时间:on + 具体某天或某天的上午下午(on Monday, on May 1st)
时间:in + 年、月、季节、上午下午晚上(in 2026, in May, in spring, in the morning)
地点:at + 小地点(at the bus stop, at home, at school)
地点:on + 表面、街道(on the table, on the wall)
地点:in + 大地点、内部(in Beijing, in the box, in the classroom)

examples.en: We have an English class at eight o'clock.
My birthday is on June 5th.
He was born in 2010.
The keys are in the box on the table.
examples.zh: 钥匙在桌上那个盒子里。

questions.prompt: School starts ___ eight thirty in the morning.
questions.explanation: 具体时刻 eight thirty 前用 at。

questions.prompt: We don't have any classes ___ Sunday.
questions.explanation: 具体某一天 Sunday 前用 on。

questions.prompt: The flowers in the park open ___ spring.
questions.explanation: 季节 spring 前用 in。

questions.prompt: My grandparents live ___ Shanghai with my uncle.
questions.explanation: 大城市 Shanghai 前用 in。

questions.prompt: There is a lamp and some books ___ the desk.
questions.explanation: 桌面是表面,用 on。

questions.prompt: He goes to bed late ___ night.
questions.explanation: at night 是固定搭配。

title: some / any 与可数、不可数名词
summary: some 多用于肯定句,any 多用于否定句和疑问句;可数名词有复数,不可数名词没有,many 配可数、much 配不可数。
points: 可数名词有单复数:an apple → two apples
常见不可数名词:water, rice, money, paper, bread, milk
some 一般用于肯定句:I have some questions.
any 一般用于否定句和疑问句:I don't have any money.
表示请求或提议的疑问句用 some:Would you like some tea?
many + 可数名词复数;much + 不可数名词;how many / how much 分别对二者提问
a lot of / lots of 既可接可数名词也可接不可数名词

examples.en: I have some questions about this lesson.
examples.zh: 关于这一课我有一些问题。

examples.en: There isn't any milk in the fridge.
Would you like some coffee?
How much money do you need for the book?
examples.zh: 买这本书你需要多少钱?

questions.prompt: There are ___ apples in the basket on the table.
questions.explanation: 肯定句中用 some,apples 是可数名词复数。

questions.prompt: I don't have ___ money with me today.
questions.explanation: 否定句中用 any,而且 money 是不可数名词。

questions.prompt: Is there ___ water in the bottle?
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句中用 any。

questions.prompt: Would you like ___ tea before dinner?
questions.explanation: 表示提议的疑问句用 some。

questions.prompt: How ___ books do you have in your bag?
questions.explanation: books 可数,提问用 how many。

questions.prompt: 下面哪个名词是不可数名词?
questions.explanation: rice(大米)不可数,没有复数形式。

title: 祈使句与 Let's do sth.
summary: 祈使句以动词原形开头表请求/命令/建议;Let's + 动词原形表"我们一起做"。
points: 肯定祈使句:动词原形开头(Open the door.)
否定祈使句:Don't + 动词原形(Don't be late.)
Let's + 动词原形:建议包含说话双方
Let's not + 动词原形:建议不做某事
礼貌度:Please Open... / Please don't...
祈使句主语 you 通常省略

examples.en: Please close the window.
Don't worry about the exam.
Let's take a walk after dinner.

questions.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头,选 Be。

questions.prompt: ___ run in the hallway. It's dangerous.
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句用 Don't + 动词原形。

questions.prompt: Let's ___ the bus instead of walking.
questions.explanation: Let's 后接动词原形。

questions.prompt: ___ your homework first, and then you can watch TV.
questions.explanation: 祈使句动词原形开头,选 Do。

questions.prompt: It's a lovely day. ___ not go out for a picnic?
questions.explanation: Let's not / Shall we 变体;此处建议句用 Let's。

questions.prompt: ___ be late for school again, Tom!
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句:Don't be late。

title: 连词 and / but / or / so
summary: 四个基础连词连接对等成分:and 表并列,but 表转折,or 表选择,so 表因果。
points: and 并列:I like tea and coffee.
but 转折:cheap but good
or 选择:tea or coffee?
so 结果(前面是原因):It rained, so we stayed home.
注意 so 与 because 不同句:Because it rained, we stayed home.
连词连接的成分形式须一致

examples.en: I have a brother and a sister.
examples.zh: 我有一个哥哥和一个姐姐。

examples.en: The bag is small but heavy.
Hurry up, or we'll miss the train.
examples.zh: 快点,不然我们就赶不上火车了。

questions.prompt: I like music ___ I don't like sports.
questions.explanation: 前后意思转折,用 but。

questions.prompt: It was late, ___ we took a taxi home.
questions.explanation: 前因后果,用 so。
二选一用 or。

questions.prompt: She can sing ___ dance very well.
questions.explanation: 两项都能,表并列用 and。

questions.prompt: Study hard, ___ you will fail the test.
questions.explanation: "否则"的否定结果用 or。

questions.prompt: The phone is cheap, ___ it works well.
questions.explanation: 便宜却好用,转折用 but。

title: how many / how much 与数量表达
summary: how many 接可数名词复数,how much 接不可数名词;how much 还可问价格。
points: how many + 可数复数:How many books?
how much + 不可数:How much water?
how much 问价格:How much is it?
a lot of / lots of 既接可数也接不可数
many/few 配可数,much/little 配不可数
some 肯定句,any 疑问否定(呼应 g-114)

examples.en: How many students are there in your class?
How much milk do you need?
How much is this hat?

questions.prompt: How ___ eggs do we have left?
questions.explanation: eggs 可数复数,用 many。
问价格用 how much。

questions.prompt: There isn't ___ water in the bottle.
questions.explanation: water 不可数,否定句用 much。

questions.prompt: I have ___ friends here, so I never feel lonely.
questions.explanation: friends 可数,肯定句用 a lot of。

questions.prompt: Hurry up! We only have ___ time.
questions.explanation: time 不可数,肯定含义用 a little。

questions.prompt: ___ bottles of juice shall we buy?
questions.explanation: bottles 可数复数,用 How many。

title: have / have got 的用法
summary: 表达"拥有"可用 have 或 have got;英式口语爱用 have got,疑问否定借 got 或助动词 do。
points: 肯定:I have a car. = I have got a car. = I've got a car.
疑问:Do you have...? / Have you got...?
否定:I don't have... / I haven't got...
have 表动作(吃饭/上课)时不能用 got:have lunch
have to 表必须(呼应情态动词)
美式多用 do/does 构成疑问否定

examples.en: She has two cats.
Have you got a pen I can borrow?
We have lunch at twelve every day.
examples.zh: 我们每天十二点吃午饭。

questions.explanation: Have you got...? 是英式疑问式。

questions.prompt: He ___ have a bike, so he walks to school.
questions.explanation: 美式否定 doesn't have;hasn't 后缺 got 不成立。
表动作"吃晚饭"用 have,不能加 got。

questions.prompt: She ___ a beautiful garden behind her house.
questions.explanation: 第三人称单数 has got 表拥有。

questions.prompt: ___ your brother have a driving licence?
questions.explanation: 美式疑问用 Does + 动词原形 have。

questions.prompt: I ___ any money with me today.
questions.explanation: 否定"没有"用 don't have(any 提示否定)。

title: 方位介词:in front of / behind / between / next to
summary: 描述物体相对位置的四个常用介词短语,注意 between 后接 and。
points: in front of 在…前面(外部)
behind 在…后面
between A and B 在 A 和 B 之间(两者)
among 用于三者及以上之间
next to / beside 在…旁边
in the front of 指"内部的前部"(如教室前排)

examples.en: A cat is sitting in front of the door.
The garden is behind the house.
The bank is between the school and the park.
examples.zh: 银行在学校和公园之间。
